visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A sturdy English Bulldog stands upright in a deep snowy field, dressed in a festive red Santa Claus jacket with white fur trim, green shorts, and bright red mittens. The dog has its pink tongue sticking out playfully. Behind it, several Christmas trees are decorated with glowing warm lights and surrounded by colorful gift boxes near a wooden gazebo. (2) The dog begins a rhythmic swaying dance, shifting its weight from side to side. Suddenly, a heavy flurry of digital snow begins to whip around the dog in a circular motion. The blizzard grows in intensity, partially obscuring the dog's red suit as white particles coat its entire body rapidly. (3) The swirling snow settles, revealing the bulldog completely transformed into a frozen white snow-sculpture version of itself. It remains in the same upright pose with its tongue still visible, now appearing as a living snowman. The background remains a festive, lit holiday scene with gentle snow falling in the bokeh-blurred distance.

Large wrapped gift boxes in red, green, and gold are scattered on the ground. A rustic wooden structure with more lights is visible on the left.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, pop-remix version of 'Jingle Bells'. A male voice sings with an enthusiastic, bright tone: 'Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way'. The music features a prominent electronic beat and synthesized holiday bells at a steady dance tempo. (2) As the visual snow intensifies, a distinct synthesized whoosh sound effect is layered over the music, mimicking the sound of a sudden blizzard. The vocals continue with a humorous twist on the lyrics, singing: 'It's snowing baby, know that Santa will give you Dr. Pepper'. (3) The vocal delivery becomes more stylized and rhythmic, ending with a final emphatic punch on the words 'Dr. Pepper'. The music maintains its driving electronic beat until the very end of the clip, where the track cuts off cleanly with a slight vocal echo.
